findings.thesis: THE THIRD BASE RUNS, AND THE WING-COUNT CHANGE BREAKS THE TWO-WING LAWS IN A MEASURED, NAMED WAY -- inside one declared finite model, at its declared scope, with nothing claimed about nature.  THE BASE: three wings, carrier 64, the wing symmetry group S_3 measured non-abelian and measured to be EXACTLY the group the j0 filter admits, the six leg-orders as native frames, a 9-member preparation family whose entanglement class is computed from Cayley's hyperdeterminant, and one completion per member chosen by a declared lex-first-within-property rule and pinned entry by entry.  A1: the completion census is exhaustive at 5040 completions and the maximum defect order the carrier admits is 6, measured; the two-wing law |Hol| = 2.ord([P,u]) holds at 0 of 4 swept targets, and the holonomy orders measured are (1,1008,72,15120) -- the dihedral family does NOT survive, and the order is not a function of ord([P,u]) at one symmetry.  A2: the committed four-factor product P u^-1 P u reproduces the measured transport defect at 36 of 54 cells and the GROUP COMMUTATOR form at 54, so the law generalises rather than holding verbatim -- the four-factor writing was an involution artifact, and at the three-cycles it does not even split off the pointer factor; the cocycle delta_P(XY) = delta_P(Y).Y^-1 delta_P(X) Y survives VERBATIM with 0 deviations.  A3: the native atlas has (6,36) charts over six seeds, the census runs to (600,216720,343296,1226304) admissible triangles at the reference instance by two independent routes, and the committed centralizer criterion agrees with the measured closure at 4 of 5 instances while the computed NORMALISER refinement agrees at 5 -- the necessity direction of the committed biconditional is measured false where the triangles are not engineered.  A4: the state factor is the identity exactly on the invariant locus, 0 deviations over 54 cells; GHZ-class and W-class preparations are measured to carry DIFFERENT geometries at identical declarations ((2160,2160,2160) against (6,4,1,None)); and the exhaustive pair census finds fixed-Born-shadow witness pairs ((psi-W1,psi-W4)).  A5: the committed 8/13/6 does not transfer ((30,150,121) here), and of the eight declared survival candidates (S2,S3,S4) survive and (S1,S5,S6,S7,S8) do not.  Controls: the same machinery run at two wings reproduces the committed two-wing graph, walk counts, group-order law and class-count profiles on a carrier neither committed unit used, every one anchored exit-1 against the hash-pinned XBA receipt.

gates.claim: THE DECLARATIONS ARE FROZEN BEFORE ANY TRANSPORT DATUM IS EVALUATED.  Every law, occupied set, admission table, graph, holonomy and defect in this instrument is computed through a counter that refuses to run before this point; the counter is measured HERE and must read zero.  The `freeze-lax` mutant evaluates one law datum first and dies here.  What this gate records is the ordering WITHIN ONE EXECUTION; it is not, and is not offered as, proof that the declarations were fixed before any fixture truth was seen, which no in-run measurement can establish

THE CARRIER IS THREE WINGS OF SYSTEM DIMENSION 2 AND POINTER DIMENSION 2, and the index map is a measured bijection from (system triple, pointer triple) onto the carrier.  Every size is computed by enumeration and none is typed

THE WING SYMMETRY GROUP IS S_3, NON-ABELIAN BY CONSTRUCTION, AND IT ACTS ON THE CARRIER.  Measured: the six wing permutations give six distinct carrier permutations, closed under composition over all 36 compositions, NOT abelian, with element orders {1,2,3}; each is measured to factorise as (system-triple permutation) . (pointer-triple permutation), the three-wing form of GEN's measured W = X_S . X_P; and the conjugation law P_pi U_w P_pi^-1 = U_{pi(w)} is measured at every one of the wing x rotation cells.  A wholesale replacement is not what this tests: the conjugation comparator is the leg on the IMAGE wing, built by the leg constructor from a different argument

THE LOCAL LEGS ARE EXACTLY ORTHOGONAL, THE RECORD IS INJECTIVE, AND LEGS ON DISTINCT WINGS COMMUTE AT EVERY DECLARED PAIR.  The decomposition U_w = sum_o Pi^g_o (x) Sh^o is MEASURED, not assumed, and its comparator is assembled from the PINNED rotation matrices and the INDEPENDENTLY DECLARED shift table -- so a perturbation of the rotation constructor or of the shift map moves one side of the comparison and not the other.  Injectivity of the shift is what makes the pointer value at the final division event a RECORD of the outcome; commuting is the fact the six-frame atlas rests on

THE SETTING FAMILY IS EVERY ASSIGNMENT OF A DECLARED ROTATION TO EACH WING, AND ITS SYMMETRY TYPE IS COMPUTED, NEVER TYPED.  At two wings a setting is symmetric or it is not; at three wings the stabiliser in S_3 takes THREE values, and the census measures them: order 6 (fully symmetric), order 2 (partially symmetric -- a type that does not exist at two wings) and order 1.  The three counts are measured to sum to the family size

THE FRAMES ARE THE 3! = 6 LEG-ORDERS -- the native six-frame atlas.  Triple overlaps are not constructed here; they are what the base HAS.  All six frames are measured to carry the SAME leg multiset (one distinct multiset over six frames), so they differ in order alone; the checkpoints, division events, node count and path bound are all computed from the leg count

THE PREPARATION FAMILY IS DECLARED AS DATA AND EVERY PROPERTY OF IT IS COMPUTED.  Only the name, the exact rational coefficients and the role are declared; the norm, the ENTANGLEMENT CLASS (by Cayley's 2x2x2 hyperdeterminant -- non-zero exactly on the GHZ SLOCC class -- together with the three single-wing ranks), the wing stabiliser, the Born-shadow stabiliser and the completion's orthogonality are all measured.  The pin requires at least two GHZ-class, at least two W-class and at least one non-symmetric member: the counts are measured here, not typed.  Every member is an exact rational unit vector whose completion is exactly orthogonal with psi as its first column, so every member is a legitimate preparation of the very same declared form

gates.claim: THE FOUR COMMITTED TERMINAL RECEIPTS THIS UNIT ANCHORS AGAINST ARE HASH-PINNED BY SHA-256, and the pin is a TYPED CONSTANT of this instrument gated against the hash of the bytes actually read -- so a receipt that changes under this unit kills the run rather than silently re-anchoring it.  Every reused number below is READ from those bytes rather than typed here.  The `pin-hash` mutant perturbs the bytes before they are hashed and dies here

THE COMPLETION CENSUS IS EXHAUSTIVE AT THE DECLARED SCOPE AND IS READ BY TWO GENUINELY INDEPENDENT ROUTES.  Route 2 computes ord([P,u]) from the LABEL formula sigma^-1 q^-1 sigma q on the eight system triple labels -- no matrix is built; route 1 builds the 64x64 preparation leg, forms the transport commutator and reads its order off the resulting carrier permutation.  The census size is the one the declaration forces, computed as a factorial here and compared against the enumeration; the `ordcensus-half` mutant halves the enumeration and dies on that comparison.  The maximum order the carrier admits is MEASURED, never typed

A1, THE ORD-SWEEP, AND ITS VERDICT DERIVED HERE FROM THE MEASURED COUNTS.  Completions are selected BY THE DECLARED RULE -- the lexicographically first label permutation fixing label 0 whose defect at P* has the target order -- at orders 1, 2, 3 and the measured maximum, and at each the holonomy group is computed by the two independent routes and gated equal.  THE PRE-REGISTERED QUESTION is whether the two-wing law |Hol| = 2.ord([P,u]) survives the wing-count change.  The verdict is CONFIRMED -- meaning the pre-registered probe returns a decision -- exactly when the dihedral prediction is measured to FAIL at at least one target, which is what 'S_3's non-abelianity opens a larger family' MEANS as a measurement; it is REFUTED if the dihedral law survives every target.  Both branches are live and the branch taken is computed from the hit count, never typed

A2, THE ONE LAW AT S_3, WITH ITS VERDICT AND ITS QUALIFIER DERIVED HERE FROM THE MEASURED COUNTS.  Three candidate forms are evaluated blind against the defect the CHART RULE actually produces -- read off the conjugated leg matrices, so the comparator is not the formula under test -- at every (member, wing symmetry) cell.  The cell count is the one the declaration forces.  HOLDS-VERBATIM requires the committed four-factor product to reproduce the measured defect at EVERY cell; GENERALIZES requires some other form to do so while the committed one does not, and the qualifier then CARRIES THE MEASURED COUNTS; FAILS requires no form to work and names a witness cell.  The cocycle identity delta_P(XY) = delta_P(Y) . Y^-1 delta_P(X) Y is measured at every cell, and the instantiation at the declared factorisation V = H(psi).Q is measured to reproduce the measured defect.  The verdict is re-derived inside this gate from the recorded table by a second evaluation and gated against the emitted one

gates.claim: THE COCYCLE IDENTITY IS FORCED BY ALGEBRA FOR ANY INVERTIBLE P AND ANY INVERTIBLE X, Y -- one line -- and is recorded as a DISCLOSURE rather than advertised as a discovery.  What is NOT forced is the ORDER, and that is measured: the mirror-ordered expansion computes delta(YX).  The sweep is not vacuous in either direction, and the generator is seeded by the SHA-256 of the declared data alone, so two runs draw the same sequence

THE COCYCLE SWEEP IS NON-VACUOUS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: the mirror order is measured to give a DIFFERENT answer on a measured majority of the draws, and a measured majority of the draws have a non-trivial delta, so the identity is not being confirmed on trivial input.  The `cocycle-subsample` mutant shrinks the sweep below the declared size and dies on the size comparison

A3, THE NATIVE TRIANGLE CENSUS, WITH ITS VERDICT DERIVED HERE.  The atlas is the orbit of the SIX committed leg-order frames under the admitted group, deduplicated by chart identity; the pair table is COC's four-clause predicate generalised verbatim to ordered chart pairs; and the census is taken by TWO GENUINELY INDEPENDENT ROUTES -- adjacency lists walking drawn edges, and a direct triple loop over every ordered triple with dictionary lookups -- whose triangle and escape counts are gated equal.  A3 is CONFIRMED when every declared instance returns a census by both routes in agreement; the SCIENTIFIC content is the criterion table, which is reported as measured and is not what the verdict asserts.  The `tri-cell-drop` mutant drops one checkpoint from route 1 and dies on the route comparison; the `a3-drop` mutant drops an instance and dies on the instance count

COC gated the criterion at two atlases it built; this unit measures it at five instances of a base that was not designed around it, and reports BOTH the committed biconditional and a computed refinement -- normalises in place of centralises -- with their agreement counts against the measured closure.  The census has TEETH in both directions: it is measured to find escapes at some instances and none at others, so a zero escape count is a measurement and not a property of the instrument.  This gate requires the census to be non-degenerate -- at least one instance closing and at least one escaping -- and requires the two criteria's agreement counts to be computed from the same rows

gates.claim: A4, THE psi-FAMILY, WITH ITS VERDICT AND ITS COMPUTED QUALIFIER DERIVED HERE.  The state factor E_P(psi) = delta_P(H(psi)) is computed per wing symmetry at every member, and the characterisation -- E_P is the identity IF AND ONLY IF psi is invariant under that wing symmetry -- is measured in BOTH directions at every (member, symmetry) cell, with the cell count the declaration forces.  The unordered-pair census is exhaustive at the declared family size, computed as a binomial here and compared against the enumeration.  The qualifier `-AT-FIXED-BORN-SHADOW` is NOT a literal: it is appended exactly when the census measures a pair that shares a Born shadow, agrees cell for cell on its admission table, and still carries a common NAMED loop whose gauge-invariant Born holonomy differs -- three measured conditions, all required

gates.claim: THE POSITIVE CONTROL: THE SAME GENERIC MACHINERY, RUN AT TWO WINGS, REPRODUCES THE COMMITTED TWO-WING TRANSPORT STRUCTURE ON A CARRIER NEITHER COMMITTED UNIT USED -- qubit systems and two-state pointers, 16 configurations against base 1's 36 and base G's 81.  The completion family is swept by RULE and the defect orders it realises are MEASURED.  Anchored exit-1 against the hash-pinned XBA receipt: 8 nodes, 13 links, cycle rank 6, 7 identification links, the based closed reduced walk count, the all-base-point closed and reduced walk counts, the class-count profile and the group order at the realised defect order.  Anchored exit-1 against the hash-pinned PSI receipt at BOTH realised orders, including the order-1 case in which the identifications are REFUSED and the graph loses two links -- a row the fixed-graph census cannot express and which therefore could only come from a transport-native instrument.  The walk census is taken by TWO independent routes, an enumerator that builds every walk and a transfer recursion that counts without building one, and both are anchored.  This is the control that gives the three-wing measurement its teeth: the code under test is the code that reproduces the committed base

gates.claim: THE NEGATIVE CONTROLS HAVE TEETH.  An EQUIVARIANT completion must make every wing symmetry intertwine the preparation leg and collapse the geometry to a point; a DIFFERENT declared transposition must move the holonomy order; an ASYMMETRIC setting must remove the wing symmetries from the admitted maps and flatten the transport.  All three are measured to move the geometry away from the reference, and at least one is measured exactly flat.  The `negcontrol-lax` mutant replaces every control completion by the declared one -- so the controls stop being controls -- and dies here

THE SYMMETRY SELF-TEST (RUNBOOK section 14).  The declared switching action is applied to the instrument's own holonomy readings and the quantity's invariance under the symmetry's own action is MEASURED: the Born-shadow reading is invariant at every (switching, generator) cell and the permutation part is invariant as a permutation, while the sign the switching carries is measured to move on a non-zero number of cells, so the sweep is not vacuous.  TWO FURTHER CLAUSES, both with an INDEPENDENT COMPARATOR: every generator is REBUILT from its own directed link path by the walk-holonomy routine -- which shares no code with the spanning-tree construction that produced it -- and gated equal; and with every link switched, the rebuilt holonomy is gated equal to the unswitched one times the parity read independently off the path length, with the count of negative-parity cells gated non-zero so the sign path is measured to be exercised.  The self-test evaluates FRESH: the cache is primed with the very keys it requests, the priming phase's own re-read is counted, the fresh-mode hit count is gated at zero, and the count of fresh requests for a key already in the cache is gated NON-ZERO -- zero hits of zero lookups would be vacuous

WHICH CLAUSES DECIDE ANYTHING AT THIS BASE, MEASURED.  Each clause of the committed four-clause predicate is dropped in turn and the admission table recomputed; the cells whose drawn table moves are counted.  The gate requires at least one clause to be measured load-bearing -- a predicate none of whose clauses does anything decides nothing -- and it is stated as a measurement because the answer at THIS base is that only ONE of the four moves the table: the others' content is implied by it here, which is a fact about this base and not a defect of the predicate.  The mutant that drops a clause is targeted at the clause measured load-bearing, so the falsifier is one that can fire

Every census size in this unit is COMPUTED from the declaration -- a product, a factorial or a binomial evaluated here -- and gated against the size the corresponding table actually reports.  A census that silently drops a cell, a target, an instance, a pair or an anchor moves one side of a comparison and not the other, and dies here.  Nine independent cell counts are gated, each against its own denominator

THE UNIT VERDICT IS DERIVED INSIDE THIS GATE FROM THE MEASURED COUNTS AND GATED AGAINST THE STRING THAT WAS EMITTED (RUNBOOK section 13 addendum, #234).  THE RULE, pre-registered: TB3-BASE-ESTABLISHED if the base runs and ALL FIVE AXES return verdicts; otherwise TB3-BLOCKED-AT-<object> naming the first axis that did not.  The re-derivation counts the AXIS TABLES actually recorded in the receipt, which is a different quantity from the axis verdict strings the emitter counts, so a perturbation of either side moves one and not the other.  Every axis verdict is additionally checked to lie in the pre-registered vocabulary.  The `verdict-order` mutant swaps the branch order, `verdict-lax` emits an out-of-vocabulary string and `verdict-nowitness` empties the emitter's input while the recorded tables keep their measurements -- all three die here

EVERY DECLARATION GATE SITS STRICTLY BEFORE THE FIRST TRANSPORT GATE IN THE RECEIPT'S OWN GATE ORDER, AND THE FREEZE IS THE FIRST GATE OF ALL.  The `order-lax` mutant emits a transport measurement before the declarations and dies here

NO GATE PREDICATE REFERENCES MUTANT IDENTITY (RUNBOOK section 14 addendum, #208).  An AST sweep of this source looks for every negated comparison against the mutant flag -- `MUTANT != ...`, `MUTANT not in ...`, `MUTANT is not ...` and `not (MUTANT == ...)` -- and the set is measured EMPTY.  Every mutation is injected in a computation, and each declared falsifier must die by the gates' own predicates evaluated blind.  The `exempt-lax` mutant registers an exemption in this gate's own evidence list after the sweep -- a WAIVER, declared as one

THE ARITHMETIC IS EXACT.  An AST sweep of this instrument's own source finds NO float literal anywhere; every number that enters a measurement is a Python integer or a Fraction, and every matrix entry is a Fraction.  The `float-lax` mutant registers a float in this gate's own evidence list after the sweep has run -- the source text is never edited, so it is declared a WAIVER

EVERY MUST-PASS GATE IS FALSIFIED BY SOME MUTANT, AND EVERY MUTANT DIES.  Each declared mutant is run to completion, must exit 1, and must falsify at least one NAMED gate or anchor; the second clause is the one that matters -- the set of must-pass gates that NO mutant falsifies is measured to be EMPTY.  Each mutant declares its KIND and the split is counted from the declaration: a WAIVER proves a gate's predicate is load-bearing for the exit code, not that the gate would catch a computational defect, and the two are not claimed to be the same thing.  BOTH DENOMINATORS ARE REPORTED because they differ, and the gates carried by a waiver alone are NAMED, never averaged away.  The one gate excluded from the denominator is this one: the census does not run inside a mutant
